style: Painted character illustration for a point-and-click adventure, in exactly the style of the attached reference image: the same 1940s film-noir painted look, the same brush texture and level of detail, strictly black-and-white greyscale with no colour at all, hard single key light from the upper left, deep blacks and crisp highlights, a crisp readable silhouette, slightly elongated stylised proportions. Full figure from the top of the head (or hat) to the soles of the shoes, standing in a relaxed three-quarter view facing the left of the frame like the reference, both arms and hands visible, feet flat on the ground, the whole figure filling about 88% of the image height with a small margin all round. Plain flat pure chroma-key green background (#00FF00) everywhere, no floor, no cast shadow, no props unless described, no text, no border. This is a different person from the reference: take only the art style from it, not the face, body or clothes. New York, winter 1930.
accent_note: Greyscale only, except Inéz Venta's lips, which are a deep red (#B3141F); nothing else on any character is coloured.

characters.name: Matt Long
characters.look: Matt Long, 37, private investigator and ex-NYPD detective. Tall, lean, a little stooped with tiredness. Rumpled grey single-breasted three-piece suit, white shirt, loosened dark tie, a fedora with a dented crown, two-day stubble, tired sharp eyes, square jaw. Hands relaxed at his sides.

characters.name: Pete Duckerton
characters.look: Pete Duckerton, 35, crime reporter. The same man as the third reference image: his face, dark brown untidy hair and build, clearly a man of 35 with faint lines round the eyes and a day's stubble, an eager grin, slim and gangly. Dressed exactly as in the second reference image: fedora pushed back on his head with a press card tucked in the hatband, rumpled striped suit, long knitted scarf hanging untied round his neck, a rolled-up newspaper in one hand, the other hand in his trouser pocket.

characters.name: Kate Duckerton
characters.look: Kate Duckerton, about 33, accountant. Neat dark bob, round wire-rimmed spectacles, composed and precise, slightly shorter than average. A tailored belted wool coat over a plain calf-length dress, sensible low-heeled shoes, holding a cloth-bound ledger against her chest with both hands.

characters.name: Natalia Long (née Kowalska)
characters.look: Natalia Long, about 34, Polish immigrant who works in a Greenpoint bakery. Strong features, sturdy build, hair pinned up under a modest small felt Sunday hat. Plain long-sleeved working dress with a white apron, flour dusted on her sleeves and forearms, arms folded, a blunt steady look.

characters.name: Inéz Venta
characters.look: Inéz Venta, about 28, glamorous society girl whose family has secretly lost everything. Slim and poised. Platinum-blonde finger-waved hair, dark eyes, the only colour on her is deep red lipstick (#B3141F). A long fitted coat with a big fur collar, the coat visibly mended once too often at a cuff, a small clutch bag in one gloved hand, elegant heeled shoes.

characters.name: Capt. Dr. Michael Harlan
characters.look: Captain Dr. Michael Harlan, 36, US Army Medical Corps surgeon decorated in France. Square-jawed, upright military bearing, short neat hair, clean-shaven. 1930 US Army officer's service uniform: olive-drab wool tunic with four pockets and Sam Browne belt, matching trousers, polished shoes, a medical corps collar badge, campaign ribbons; service cap held under one arm.

characters.name: Michael Harlan (wounded, Act 3)
characters.look: The same Captain Dr. Michael Harlan, 36, square-jawed, now gaunt and feverish after being stabbed: unshaven, hollow cheeks, damp hair, wearing a borrowed loose white undershirt and trousers with braces, a bandage around his ribs showing under the shirt, one hand pressed to his side, barefoot, standing unsteadily.

characters.name: Julian Moss
characters.look: Julian Moss, about 30, Black jazz pianist at a Village speakeasy. Slim and elegant, long fingers, a guarded half smile, neatly pomaded short hair, pencil moustache. A sharp double-breasted three-piece suit, silk pocket square, two-tone shoes, one hand resting in his trouser pocket.

characters.name: Lt. Frank Corrigan
characters.look: Lieutenant Frank Corrigan, about 50, NYPD vice-squad detective. Heavyset and broad, red-faced (rendered in grey), thick neck, fatherly smile that doesn't reach the eyes. An immaculate long dark double-breasted overcoat, homburg hat, gloves, a rosary with a small crucifix looped over the fingers of one hand.

characters.name: Salvatore "Sal" Brancato
characters.look: Salvatore 'Sal' Brancato, about 50, bootlegger and owner of a haulage company and social clubs. Small and elegant, noticeably shorter than average, calm and still, slicked-back greying hair, thin moustache. An expensive tailored dark three-piece suit, a pale silk tie, a white carnation in the lapel, grey spats over polished shoes, a slim cigar between two fingers.

characters.name: Arthur Whitcombe
characters.look: Arthur Whitcombe, about 60, vice-president of a pharmaceutical company and philanthropist. Tall, thin, distinguished, silver hair neatly parted, pince-nez glasses on a cord. A conservative dark three-piece suit with a watch chain, a small charity pin on his lapel, a walking stick with a silver handle.

characters.name: Harold Grayson
characters.look: Harold Grayson, about 55, Washington government official. Deliberately forgettable: average height, average build, thinning grey hair, a bland unremarkable face, round steel spectacles. A plain grey three-piece suit, plain tie, a grey overcoat over one arm and a leather briefcase in the other hand.

characters.name: Lee Wing
characters.look: Lee Wing, about 60, Chinese-American owner of a tea house in Chinatown. Slight, older man, calm watchful eyes, short grey hair, wire glasses pushed up on his forehead. A buttoned knitted cardigan over a collarless shirt, loose dark trousers, cloth slippers, hands clasped in front of him.

characters.name: Sol Abramowitz
characters.look: Sol Abramowitz, about 65, Jewish pawnbroker on the Bowery. Stooped, bald on top with a fringe of white hair, bushy eyebrows, a jeweller's loupe on a cord, a knitted waistcoat over a shirt with sleeve garters, dark trousers, a pencil behind his ear, wary expression.

characters.name: Alley junkie (Prologue)
characters.look: A thin, jittery young man in his twenties who sleeps in a Bowery alley. Hollow cheeks, unshaven, hair uncombed, a too-big threadbare overcoat with the collar turned up, fingerless gloves, a flat cap, worn-out shoes, shoulders hunched, hands tucked under his arms against the cold.

characters.name: Pvt. Eddie Ruiz
characters.look: Private Eddie Ruiz, about 22, Puerto Rican army orderly at the Governors Island hospital. Friendly open face, short dark hair, slim. A white hospital orderly's jacket buttoned to the collar over army olive-drab trousers, garrison cap, carrying a folded towel over one arm.

characters.name: Walter Gibbs
characters.look: Walter Gibbs, about 35, a wounded First World War veteran in withdrawal. Gaunt, sweating, haunted eyes, close-cropped hair, a scar on one cheek. Hospital-issue striped pyjamas with a grey wool army blanket clutched around his shoulders, bare feet, trembling hands.

characters.name: "Lulu"
characters.look: 'Lulu', about 40, the bartender at The Velvet Door speakeasy, a queer man with a theatrical flair. Tall, theatrical, pencil-thin moustache, hair slicked into a wave. A white shirt with sleeve garters, a satin waistcoat, a bow tie, a bar towel over one shoulder, polishing a cocktail glass. Show the whole figure, head to shoes, at the same size as the reference figure.

characters.name: Mr. Hartley
characters.look: Mr. Hartley, about 55, newspaper editor. Paunchy, balding, harried, an unlit cigar clamped in his mouth. A rumpled white shirt with rolled-up sleeves and a translucent celluloid newspaperman's eyeshade visor on a band around his forehead, pale grey, his eyes clearly visible beneath it, braces, a loosened tie, trousers, a sheaf of proof pages in one fist.

characters.name: Zofia Venta
characters.look: Zofia Venta, about 55, Inéz's Polish mother, from a once-wealthy family. Faded elegance, grey hair in a bun, a pearl necklace, a dark old-fashioned dress with lace at the collar, a knitted shawl around her shoulders, a rosary in one hand.

characters.name: Stefan
characters.look: Stefan, about 38, a Polish butcher in Greenpoint and Natalia's fiancé. Big, solid, decent, wary. Short fair hair, broad face, thick forearms. A white butcher's coat with a long apron over it, his Sunday cap in his hands.

characters.name: Nicky "Two Dimes"
characters.look: Nicky 'Two Dimes', about 30, a bookie who works for the mob. Wiry and flashy, sly grin, toothpick in his mouth. A loud checked suit, a two-tone fedora tilted to one side, a flashy tie, spats, a silver dime balanced on the thumb of one raised hand, ready to flip it.

characters.name: Mrs. Hale
characters.look: Mrs. Hale, about 60, a Black landlady who runs a Harlem rooming house. Dignified, sturdy, kind but firm. Grey hair in a neat bun, a plain dark dress with a white collar, a cardigan, an apron, reading glasses on a chain, a ring of keys in one hand.

characters.name: Sgt. Dooley
characters.look: Sergeant Dooley, about 40, Corrigan's heavy. Very large and broad-shouldered, flat-nosed, small eyes, heavy jaw. A 1930 NYPD sergeant's uniform: long dark wool tunic with brass buttons and sergeant's chevrons, a peaked police cap, a nightstick hanging from the belt, big hands.

proportions: Body proportions identical to the reference figure: about 7.5 heads tall, the head the same size relative to the body as the reference's head, legs the same length relative to the body, shoulders at the same relative height. A heavier or older build is shown only by width, posture and clothing, never by a bigger head or shorter legs.
